meta.name: InWonder
meta.description:
Shows about the worlds of science, technology and knowledge. Prepare to be taken on a factual adventure!

Shows: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker", Ancient Engineering S2 - "History's Hidden Marvels", Exceptional Engineering S1 - "Emergency Helicopter", Made in Britain S1 - "Whitaker's Chocolates and Heck! Sausages", Made in Britain S1 - "Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies"
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
